result.markdown:
If you mean **lawyers representing injured workers** in Adelaide—not lawyers acting for employers/insurers—there are several strong options. I’d put the following at the top of the shortlist based on the latest 2026 Doyle’s Guide rankings, specialist focus, and local client-review signals.

### My Adelaide shortlist

1. **Tindall Gask Bentley, Adelaide (TGB)**  
   One of the strongest choices for a serious or complicated workplace-injury claim. TGB is in the **“Leading”** tier of Doyle’s 2026 South Australian work-injury law-firm rankings. Barney Gask is ranked **Preeminent** among individual work-injury lawyers. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/work-injury-compensation-law-firms-plaintiff-south-australia/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)  
   **Best for:** complex claims, serious injuries, disputes and substantial compensation claims.

2. **Johnston Withers Lawyers**  
   A particularly strong Adelaide option with a long history in personal injury law. The firm is **Leading** in Doyle’s 2026 ranking, while Tim Downie, Dominic Nasone and Patrick North are individually ranked **Leading**. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/work-injury-compensation-law-firms-plaintiff-south-australia/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)  
   **Best for:** workers wanting an established SA plaintiff-side firm.

3. **DBH Lawyers**  
   DBH is also in the **Leading** tier for work-injury compensation in 2026. Matthew Arentz and Amy Nikolovski are both ranked **Preeminent**, with Peter Jackson also ranked Leading. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/work-injury-compensation-law-firms-plaintiff-south-australia/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)  
   **Best for:** significant/complex workplace injury claims.

4. **Paul Alvaro Lawyers**  
   Another standout. Paul Alvaro himself is ranked **Preeminent**, while Sarah Colvin and Vanessa Piniotti are ranked **Leading**. The firm is in Doyle’s 2026 **Leading** tier. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/work-injury-compensation-law-firms-plaintiff-south-australia/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)  
   **Best for:** specialist personal injury/work injury representation.

5. **C+F Lawyers**  
   C+F is **Leading** in the 2026 firm ranking, with Kristine Ashworth individually ranked Leading. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/work-injury-compensation-law-firms-plaintiff-south-australia/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)  
   **Best for:** a specialist plaintiff-side compensation practice with a strong current ranking.

### Other firms I'd consider

- **Andersons Solicitors** — ranked **Recommended** by Doyle's for 2026 and has a strong Adelaide presence. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/work-injury-compensation-law-firms-plaintiff-south-australia/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- **Turner Freeman Lawyers** — also Recommended in the 2026 work-injury ranking. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/work-injury-compensation-law-firms-plaintiff-south-australia/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- **Wearing & Blairs** — Recommended as a firm; Donald Blairs is individually ranked **Preeminent**. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/work-injury-compensation-law-firms-plaintiff-south-australia/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- **JDL Personal Injury Lawyers Adelaide** — worth considering based on its personal-injury focus, although it isn't in Doyle's 2026 leading work-injury firm list.

### Who I'd call first

If **I were choosing three firms to get initial advice from**, I'd start with:

**1. TGB → 2. Johnston Withers → 3. DBH**

The reason is that all three are in the **top “Leading” tier in the latest 2026 specialist work-injury rankings**, rather than simply being general Adelaide firms that happen to handle compensation cases. Doyle's says its rankings are based on peer nominations and interviews and cannot be purchased. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/work-injury-compensation-law-firms-plaintiff-south-australia/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

One important point: **the best lawyer depends heavily on what happened to you**—for example, a denied ReturnToWorkSA claim, permanent impairment, psychological injury, aggravation of a pre-existing condition, or a potential lump-sum/work-injury damages claim can require quite different expertise.

If you tell me **what type of workplace injury you have, roughly when it happened, and whether ReturnToWorkSA/your employer has accepted or rejected the claim**, I can narrow this down to **the 3 best Adelaide lawyers for your particular situation**, including who offers **no-win-no-fee** and what their reviews say.
